reviewed_by: Claude Code after independent subagent root-cause validation and scratch-Core reproduction
reason: Blocking OS credential vault calls that ran on the worker's event loop (MCP secret resolution, browser-companion credentials, MCP import vault state, reuse, save and rollback) now run in a thread with a CREDENTIAL_VAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS bound, so a hung keyring fails the operation instead of freezing the worker. Selected: MCP probe (new hung-vault regression), MCP import, browser companion suites and credentials.
exclusions: No UI, native or Playwright layer: no interface change. The worker-level effect was measured on a fake scratch Core with a scratch-only shim that makes vault resolution block forever.
